verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Logseq's core features (journals, queries, plugins, HTTP API, sync, export) but contains no documentation of a built-in AI assistant that answers questions, summarizes, or drafts grounded in the user's notes with data-scope controls; the only AI-adjacent mention is a community comment about losing third-party (Claude/Codex) integration in the DB version, which is not a native assistant.
